title: FREQUENTLY ASKED Questions
sub: Everything you need to know about our fresh cold-pressed process, catering, and delivery.

items.question: What events do you cater for?
items.answer: We cater for weddings, birthday parties, college fests, corporate events, festivals, and private gatherings of any size.

items.question: Where do you provide your service?
items.answer: We currently serve Sutton, London, Surrey, and surrounding areas across the United Kingdom.

items.question: Can I book The Cane House for a wedding?
items.answer: Yes! Our live artisanal sugarcane pressing cart is a unique and popular live beverage counter for wedding receptions.

items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: We recommend booking at least 2 to 4 weeks in advance, especially during the busy summer and wedding season.

items.question: Do you provide custom event packages?
items.answer: Yes, we tailor beverage menus, cup branding, and live counter setups to match your event theme and guest count.

items.question: Can I order sugarcane juice online?
items.answer: Yes, we provide fresh chilled doorstep delivery in eco-friendly bottles across our local delivery radius.

items.question: Do you offer franchise opportunities?
items.answer: Yes! We offer low-investment franchise setups including city kiosks, event carts, and full training and operational support.

items.question: How can I make an enquiry?
items.answer: You can fill out our enquiry form on the website, call us at +44 7770 461 999, or email thecanehouseuk@gmail.com.
